description: Official Derrick server image (open core). Application delivery platform, MPL 2.0.
aboutText:
## Derrick server

Official container image for the [Derrick](https://github.com/nomatronio/derrick) server.

Derrick is a developer-centric, multi-runtime application delivery platform. Open-core fork of HashiCorp Waypoint v0.11.4 (MPL 2.0).

- Source: https://github.com/nomatronio/derrick
- License: https://github.com/nomatronio/derrick/blob/main/LICENSE
usageText:
## Pull

```bash
docker pull public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick:latest
```

## Install

```bash
derrick install -platform=docker -accept-tos \
  -docker-server-image=public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick:latest \
  -docker-odr-image=public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick-odr:latest
```
